fields.status: Work in progress. The default build demonstrates PS3 ELF/game-main startup, SPURS/EDGE activity, and a custom animated test scene over cycling game images; actual game menus and geometry are not established. Experimental game-world/menu probes are off by default, and audio/input remain stubbed.
fields.summary: Static Windows x64 recompilation of the PS3 Budokai HD Collection release using ps3recomp. Current default output is a test renderer with game textures, not verified gameplay; the user must provide the decrypted EBOOT and original disc data.

sources.label: Maintainer README: current default-build output, gated experiments, and unimplemented gameplay/audio/input

updates.evidence_note: The README distinguishes its default animated sphere/background viewer from gated game-world and menu experiments, and explicitly says persistent menu/game rendering and input are not established.
